summary: Bytes::truncate incorrectly clears the buffer when the requested length equals or exceeds its current length. The fix changes the length only when shortening the buffer. The fix-added test truncate in tests/test_bytes.rs checks oversized, equal, and shorter lengths; reversing the implementation should fail its first equality assertion after truncate(15) clears "helloworld". Both source regions occur exactly once in their respective revisions. No builds or tests were run.
